abandon a plan: Heavy rain kept falling all morning, so we had to abandon a plan to hike up the mountain.
整個早上一直下大雨，所以我們只好放棄爬山的計畫。
abandon hope: Even after three days in the cold forest, the lost hiker refused to abandon hope of being rescued.
即使在寒冷的森林裡待了三天，迷路的登山客仍不肯放棄獲救的希望。
abandon ship: When water poured into the engine room, the captain ordered everyone to abandon ship and get into the lifeboats.
海水湧進機房時，船長命令所有人棄船並登上救生艇。
abandon one's principles: She would rather lose the election than abandon her principles and lie to the voters.
她寧願輸掉選舉，也不願背棄自己的原則去欺騙選民。
abandon the search: After searching the sea for two weeks without any sign of the boat, the coast guard decided to abandon the search.
在海上搜尋兩週仍毫無那艘船的蹤影後，海巡署決定中止搜尋。
abandon oneself to grief: After her dog died, she abandoned herself to grief and stayed in her room crying for days.
她的狗死後，她沉溺於悲傷之中，好幾天都待在房間裡哭。
absorb knowledge: Young children absorb knowledge like sponges, so it is a great age to start learning a second language.
幼童像海綿一樣吸收知識，所以這是開始學習第二語言的好年紀。
absorb the cost: Instead of raising ticket prices, the theater decided to absorb the cost of the new seats itself.
戲院決定不調漲票價，而是自行吸收新座椅的成本。
absorb the shock: These running shoes have soft soles that absorb the shock every time your feet hit the hard road.
這雙跑鞋有柔軟的鞋底，每次你的腳踩到堅硬路面時都能緩衝衝擊。
be absorbed in a book: She was so absorbed in a book about space that she didn't hear her mother calling her for dinner.
她專注於一本關於太空的書中，以至於沒聽到媽媽叫她吃晚餐。
absorb immigrants: Over the past century, the country has managed to absorb immigrants from dozens of different cultures into its society.
過去一個世紀以來，這個國家成功地將來自數十種不同文化的移民接納進社會。
absorb information: Taking short breaks while studying helps your brain absorb information more easily before a big exam.
讀書時短暫休息有助於你的大腦在大考前更容易消化資訊。
abuse one's power: The mayor was forced to resign after he was found to abuse his power by giving city jobs to his relatives.
市長被發現濫用權力、把市府職位給親戚後，被迫辭職。
abuse drugs: Teenagers who abuse drugs often suffer serious damage to their health and their schoolwork.
濫用藥物的青少年往往在健康和課業上受到嚴重的損害。
abuse the system: Some people abuse the system by claiming money for injuries they never actually had.
有些人鑽制度漏洞，為從未真正受過的傷申請理賠金。
abuse one's trust: I lent him my car keys, but he abused my trust by driving to another city without telling me.
我把車鑰匙借給他，但他辜負了我的信任，沒告訴我就開車到另一個城市。
verbally abuse someone: The coach was fired because he would verbally abuse someone on the team with cruel insults almost every day.
那位教練被開除，因為他幾乎每天都用惡毒的話言語辱罵隊上的某個人。
accelerate the process: To accelerate the process, you can fill out the visa form online instead of waiting in line at the office.
為了加速流程，你可以上網填寫簽證表格，而不必在辦公室排隊等候。
accelerate growth: The government lowered taxes for small businesses in order to accelerate growth after the long recession.
政府為小型企業減稅，以便在長期衰退後加速經濟成長。
accelerate the decline: Scientists warn that warmer seas will accelerate the decline of coral reefs around the world.
科學家警告，海水變暖將加速全球珊瑚礁的衰退。
accelerate reforms: Facing angry protests, the new president promised to accelerate reforms and finish them within one year.
面對憤怒的抗議，新總統承諾加快改革，並在一年內完成。
access the Internet: Most cafés in Taipei let customers access the Internet for free while they drink their coffee.
台北大多數咖啡館讓顧客在喝咖啡時免費連上網路。
access the data: Only managers with a special password are allowed to access the data about our customers.
只有擁有特殊密碼的經理才能存取我們顧客的資料。
access one's account: If you forget your password, you will not be able to access your account on the school website.
如果你忘記密碼，就無法登入你在學校網站上的帳戶。
access public services: The new app makes it easier for elderly people in rural areas to access public services such as health care.
這款新應用程式讓鄉下的長者更容易取得醫療等公共服務。
accommodate 200 guests: The hotel's main hall is large enough to accommodate 200 guests, so it is perfect for our wedding banquet.
這家飯店的主廳大到足以容納兩百位客人，所以很適合我們的婚宴。
accommodate different needs: The library offers quiet rooms, group tables, and soft chairs to accommodate different needs of its readers.
圖書館提供安靜的房間、小組桌和沙發，以因應讀者的不同需求。
accommodate a request: The restaurant was fully booked, but the manager tried to accommodate a request for a table by the window.
餐廳已客滿，但經理仍設法滿足一個靠窗座位的要求。
accommodate changes: Our team schedule is flexible enough to accommodate changes if a member suddenly gets sick.
我們團隊的時程夠有彈性，若有成員突然生病也能適應變化。
